title: Elevate UI Readability: Master CSS 'text-underline-offset' & 'text-decoration-thickness' for Modern Web Fonts
tweet: Beyond basic underlines! Boost #UI design & #UX with modern CSS 'text-underline-offset' & 'text-decoration-thickness'. Fine-tune web font aesthetics for superior readability. #CSSTypography #WebFonts
tip: Default browser underlines often clash with web font descenders, hindering readability and UI elegance. Master 'text-underline-offset' to precisely control the underline's vertical position relative to the text, preventing overlap. Pair it with 'text-decoration-thickness' to adjust the underline's stroke weight, ensuring it complements your chosen web fonts without being too heavy or too light. This subtle refinement significantly enhances perceived quality and user experience across your UI.
